name: ft-enumeration
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 5): the enumeration legs, browser level (r185 pins the unit level). An anonymous visitor: (1) registers with an EXISTING email -> 409 with the door's own sentence (register discloses existence BY DESIGN - the door's documented grammar); (2) logs in with an UNKNOWN email vs (3) a WRONG password for a real account -> both 401 with byte-identical bodies (nothing leaks which leg failed). No sign-in happens; the failed legs mint user.login_failed audit rows only (disclosed, re-seeded away).

steps.name: register-existing-email-409
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/auth/register', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.send(JSON.stringify({ name: 'R210 Enum Walk', email: 'jordan@example.com', password: 'r210-enum-walk-1' })); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText })()
steps.contains: status=409 body={\"error\":\"An account with this email already exists.\"}

steps.name: login-unknown-email-401
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/auth/login', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.send(JSON.stringify({ email: 'nobody-r210@example.com', password: 'testpass123' })); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText })()
steps.contains: status=401 body={\"error\":\"Email or password is incorrect.\"}

steps.name: login-wrong-password-401
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/auth/login', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.send(JSON.stringify({ email: 'jordan@example.com', password: 'wrong-password-r210' })); return 'status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText })()
steps.contains: status=401 body={\"error\":\"Email or password is incorrect.\"}

steps.name: login-legs-byte-identical
steps.expr: (() => { const leg = (email, pw) => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/auth/login', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.send(JSON.stringify({ email: email, password: pw })); return x.status + '|' + x.getAllResponseHeaders().split('\r\n').filter((h) => h.toLowerCase().startsWith('content-type')).join(';') + '|' + x.responseText }; const a = leg('nobody-r210@example.com', 'testpass123'); const b = leg('jordan@example.com', 'wrong-password-r210'); return 'unknown=[' + a + '] wrongPw=[' + b + '] identical=' + (a === b) })()
